issue.title: [A+] Document live required branch-protection checks in docs/ci.md
issue.body:
## Summary / context

Part of **A+ Process / CI**. `docs/ci.md` describes workflows but required branch-protection checks are **aspirational** (“may change over time”).

## Current vs expected

**Current:** No dated snapshot of what `main` actually requires.

**Expected:** `docs/ci.md` lists the live required checks (names matching GitHub), with date + owner note. Align with local order: format:check → lint → typecheck → test --ci (+ quality-gates as required if configured).

## Scope

**In scope**
- Read GitHub branch protection / rulesets for `main`
- Update `docs/ci.md` only (no workflow redesign unless a check is missing and agreed)

**Out of scope**
- Changing QA merge policy
- Implementing new workflows without a separate ticket

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Documented list matches GitHub settings at time of PR
- [ ] Discrepancies called out (missing required check → follow-up issue)
- [ ] Engineering/docs only — no Needs QA

## Verification / test plan

1. Compare docs ↔ GitHub UI/API
2. Link screenshot or `gh api` excerpt in PR

## Links

- `docs/ci.md`, `.github/workflows/*`
